cds_length_note: 287 amino acids x 3 nt; use 864 bp if including stop codon. Formal transcript CDS should be rechecked before regulatory-grade vector design.
subcellular_location: lysosomal fraction / acidic perinuclear lysosome context from 2025 Rabconnectin-3 study
cell_types_targeted: possibly renal tubular cells in cases with nephrocalcinosis
phenotype: severe developmental delay / intellectual disability / regression
preferred_aav_serotypes: AAV.CPP/evolved CNS capsids (research-stage alternatives; verify freedom-to-operate)
delivery_notes: CNS rescue is the primary therapeutic objective because epilepsy and neurodevelopmental impairment dominate morbidity.
ROGDI is intracellular/non-secreted; cross-correction is expected to be low, so critical target cells likely require direct transduction.
Brain + teeth creates a delivery mismatch: a CNS-directed route is unlikely to reverse established enamel defects, and dental-directed delivery will not rescue the brain.
Enamel defects may be irreversible after tooth development, so dental outcomes should be treated cautiously as secondary or non-rescuable depending on treatment age.
overexpression_rationale: ROGDI is a non-secreted intracellular scaffold/interactor linked to Rabconnectin-3/V-ATPase biology. Overexpression risk is not purine-metabolic toxicity; the concern is stoichiometric imbalance, mislocalization, or disrupted protein-complex assembly.
cross_correction_rationale: ROGDI is not known to be secreted; rescue is expected to be cell-autonomous in neurons and ameloblasts.

standardised_gt_protocol_preview.cargo_cdna: Codon-optimized human ROGDI cDNA (Q9GZN7 / 287 aa; verify 861 vs 864 bp CDS convention before construct lock)
standardised_gt_protocol_preview.promoter: hSYN1 for neuronal CNS proof-of-concept; consider endogenous/ubiquitous low-strength promoter only after overexpression and tissue requirements are tested
standardised_gt_protocol_preview.delivery_route: Systemic neonatal/early-infant IV or intrathecal delivery; route should be chosen around CNS rescue, not dental rescue
standardised_gt_protocol_preview.regulatory_pathway: IND with orphan drug designation; potency assay must be custom-built around expression/localization/Rabconnectin-3 interaction/V-ATPase functional rescue
risk_mitigations: Verify Q9GZN7 mapping by live UniProt gene-symbol query before every fixture refresh
Measure ROGDI expression, stability, localization, and Rabconnectin-3 binding rather than enzyme activity
Use lysosomal/endosomal acidification and neuronal rescue assays as functional potency candidates
Treat dental rescue as a separate unresolved delivery/timing problem
Screen anti-AAV capsid immunity and monitor for liver/CNS toxicity
